pre_reflection.text:
[Pre-reflection] Breakout strategies are notoriously whipsaw-prone, especially on volatile assets like SOLVUSDC. Relying solely on Stochastic and BBands for confirmation increases this risk; false breakouts are likely. The fixed 1.0x/2.0x ATR stop-loss/take-profit may be too tight, missing larger moves, or too loose, incurring unnecessary losses. The hypothesis of a fallback contract feels disconnected from the trading strategy itself.
[Backup plan] If negative returns, switch from Stochastic to a more robust momentum indicator like MACD. If mediocre Sharpe, widen ATR multiple for stop/take (1.5x/3.0x). If failure persists, abandon breakout and explore a trend-following strategy using EMA and RSI for entry/exit signals, prioritizing risk management with dynamic position sizing.
